statement.zh: 纳伽达与巴拉斯 1894–95 年前王朝墓地发掘出土的墓地器物与葬俗组合，构成纳伽达陶器/序列类型学基础，见 Petrie & Quibell 1896。序列标签与绝对年代须现代对照；不编造墓号。
statement.en: At Naqada and Ballas, the 1894–95 Predynastic cemetery excavations yielded cemetery object and mortuary assemblages foundational to Naqada ceramic/sequence typology, as documented in Petrie & Quibell 1896. Sequence labels and absolute dates need modern cross-check; no invented tomb inventory numbers.
